html:
G'oya

Ish ikki bosqichli. Avval har mijozning birinchi buyurtma sanasini topamiz: MIN(order_date) va GROUP BY customer_id. Endi har mijoz bitta qator va bitta sana. Keyin shu sanalardan oy kalitini olib, yana guruhlaymiz va sanaymiz.

Yechim

Oy kaliti PostgreSQL'da TO_CHAR, SQLite'da strftime bilan olinadi, qolgani bir xil.

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_date
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT TO_CHAR(first_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM first_orders
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(first_date, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY month
Faqat SQLiteWITH first_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(order_date) AS first_date
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', first_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM first_orders
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', first_date)
ORDER BY month

first_orders da har mijoz bir marta uchraydi, shuning uchun oddiy COUNT(*) yetarli.

Tuzoqlar

Oylar bo'yicha COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) shu oyda xarid qilgan hamma mijozni sanaydi, qaytib kelganlarni ham. Namunada fevralda 1- va 3-mijoz xarid qilgan, lekin 1-mijoz yanvarda kelgan, fevralning yangi mijozi faqat bitta:

Noto'g'riSELECT SUBSTR(CAST(order_date AS TEXT), 1, 7) AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers
FROM orders
GROUP BY SUBSTR(CAST(order_date AS TEXT), 1, 7)
ORDER BY month

Birinchi sanani topib, uni orders ga qaytadan JOIN qilsangiz, mijoz birinchi kunida ikki marta xarid qilgan bo'lsa ikki qator chiqadi va u ikki marta sanaladi.

Yil va oyning minimumini alohida olish ham xato. 2023-11 va 2024-02 da xarid qilgan mijoz uchun eng kichik yil 2023, eng kichik oy esa 02: natijada mavjud bo'lmagan '2023-02' chiqadi. Minimumni butun sanadan oling.

Boshqa yo'l

'YYYY-MM' matnlari sanalar bilan bir xil tartibda saralanadi. Demak, minimumni darhol oy kalitidan olsa ham bo'ladi, bu so'rov ikkala bazada ishlaydi:

SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(SUBSTR(CAST(order_date AS TEXT), 1, 7)) AS month
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
